Card Q&A.a: This is a special rule for this card that always treats it as if it also has the [Shoutmon] and [Starmons] names.
Card Q&A.q: What does this card's (Rule) mean, exactly? (*This card's "This card/Digimon is also treated as if its name is [Shoutmon] and [Starmons]" has been changed to "(Rule) Name: Also treated as [Shoutmon] and [Starmons].")

Effect: This card/Digimon is also treated as if its name is [Shoutmon] and [Starmons].
＜Material Save 1＞ (When this Digimon would be deleted, you may place 1 card in this Digimon's DigiXros requirements from this Digimon's digivolution cards under 1 of your Tamers.)
[On Play] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -3000 DP for the turn. Then, if DigiXrosing with 2 cards, delete 1 of your opponent's Digimon with 2000 DP or less.
Special Play Condition: When you would play this card, you may place specified cards from your hand/battle area under it. Each placed card reduces the play cost.
